name: Browserless
desc: Browserless is a headless browser automation tool that allows you to scrape websites, take screenshots, and more.

actions.name: capture_screenshot
actions.description: Take a screenshot of a web page

actions.name: generate_pdf
actions.description: Convert a web page to PDF

actions.name: scrape_url
actions.description: Extract content from a web page

actions.name: run_bql_query
actions.description: Execute Browser Query Language (BQL) GraphQL-based queries for advanced browser automation

actions.name: get_website_performance
actions.description: Analyze website performance metrics using Lighthouse

actions.name: get_page_content
actions.description: Load a page in a real browser and return its fully rendered HTML, including content added by JavaScript.

actions.name: smart_scrape
actions.description: Get a page as markdown, text, HTML or links. Browserless tries a fast fetch first and falls back to a real browser, proxy or CAPTCHA solving when the site blocks it.

actions.name: search_web
actions.description: Search the web (pages, news or images) and optionally read each result page as markdown.

actions.name: map_website
actions.description: List the URLs of a website from its sitemap and links, optionally ordered by relevance to a search term.

actions.name: start_crawl
actions.description: Start crawling a website in the background. Browserless follows links and scrapes every page it finds; use Get Crawl Results to read them.

actions.name: get_crawl
actions.description: Get the status of a crawl and one page of its scraped pages.

actions.name: list_crawls
actions.description: List your recent crawls with their status and progress.

actions.name: cancel_crawl
actions.description: Stop a running crawl. Pages already scraped stay available.

actions.name: unblock_page
actions.description: Open a page that blocks bots (Cloudflare, CAPTCHAs and similar) and return its HTML, cookies and a screenshot.

actions.name: run_function
actions.description: Run your own Puppeteer code in a Browserless browser and return what it returns.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

guides.title: Browserless automation
guides.excerpt: Read our quick guide on Browserless automation. Discover how it works, explore common use cases, and learn how Activepieces can help.
